mainEntity.name: How long does a typical tile or surface update project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a tile or surface update project varies based on the scope and complexity. A small bathroom tile refresh might take a few days, while a full kitchen countertop and backsplash replacement could take 1-2 weeks. Factors like material availability, demolition requirements, and drying times for adhesives and grouts all play a role. We'll provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project in Berkeley, East Bay, or surrounding areas.
